questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) In computer security,

(i) What is the meaning of the term hacking? (2 marks)

(ii) State three measures that can be implemented to prevent hacking. (3 marks)

(iii) List three problems that can result from unethical hacking. (3 marks)

(b) Show all steps in solving the following number representation problems.

(i) Convert the hexadecimal number 2C into a binary number. (2 marks)

(ii) Convert the octal number 67 into hexadecimal. (3 marks)

(iii) Perform the binary addition $1011_2 + 1101_2$. (3 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) 2C to binary (2 marks).** Each hexadecimal digit is written as 4 bits: 2 = 0010 and C = 12 = 1100. So $2C_{16} = 0010\ 1100_2 = 101100_2$.

**(ii) Octal 67 to hexadecimal (3 marks).** Each octal digit is written as 3 bits: 6 = 110 and 7 = 111, so $67_8 = 110111_2$. Regroup the bits in fours from the right: 0011 0111, that is 3 and 7. So $67_8 = 37_{16}$.

(Check: $6 \times 8 + 7 = 55$ and $3 \times 16 + 7 = 55$.)

**(iii) Binary addition (3 marks).** Add column by column from the right ($1 + 1 = 10$ in binary: write 0, carry 1):

```text
carries   1 1 1 1
            1 0 1 1
          + 1 1 0 1
          ---------
          1 1 0 0 0
```

Right column: 1 + 1 = 0 carry 1. Second: 1 + 0 + 1 = 0 carry 1. Third: 0 + 1 + 1 = 0 carry 1. Fourth: 1 + 1 + 1 = 1 carry 1. The last carry becomes the leftmost bit. So $1011_2 + 1101_2 = 11000_2$.

(Check: $11 + 13 = 24 = 16 + 8 = 11000_2$.)

(c) (i) State what you understand by backup and give one characteristic of a backup storage device. (2 marks)

(ii) Briefly explain the term portability in relation to:

- storage devices
- software

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Backup (2 marks).** A backup is a copy of files, data or programs made and kept on a separate storage device or place, so that they can be restored if the originals are lost, damaged or deleted. One characteristic of a backup storage device (any one): it has a large storage capacity (for example an external hard disk or a magnetic tape); it is removable and can be kept in a safe place; it is reliable and durable; it is cheap per unit of storage.

**(ii) Portability (2 marks, 1 mark each)**

- **Storage devices:** a portable storage device is small and light enough to be carried easily from one place to another and connected to different computers (for example a flash disk, a memory card or an external hard disk).
- **Software:** portable software can be moved to, installed on and run on different computers or different operating systems without being rewritten (or can be run from a removable device without installation).
